main_measure.name: mean 10-bar forward return on short bars minus mean over all bars (%)
main_measure.threshold: difference at most -1.0% per 10 bars with t-stat -2 or lower; 0 or above rejects

supporting_check.name: falling share on short blocks minus falling share on all blocks (points)

decided_by: Rejected: the short-minus-all difference is 0 or above, or the falling share on short bars is not above the unconditional share.
reading: Short blocks are grid bars (positions 0,10,20,... of each window with t+10 inside the window) with forecast < 0, compared by Welch t against all grid bars, and a downward cross is counted each time the raw SMA50-SMA200 spread (last_history_value) goes from >= 0 to < 0 inside a window; the minimum counts are checked first, then the reject rule, then the confirm rule.
